Spellbook 0.4.2 — Michael Davis and Spellbook contributors
Upstream: https://github.com/helix-editor/spellbook
Source release: https://crates.io/crates/spellbook/0.4.2
Upstream .crate SHA-256: 0d204abcbdf8e88729306a8d0ca01a79d8a49969fe1f84696909d6dbc4321c1a
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (LICENSE).

WordCraft changes (2026-10-18, 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-25):
- src/checker.rs: apply a signed Hungarian syllable-count modifier with
  saturating_add_signed instead of casting a negative i16 to usize. The original
  addition overflowed in debug builds for e.g. "árvíztűrő"; release overflow also
  depended on platform arithmetic. An independent synthetic regression lives in
  src/checker.rs; WordCraft also tests its real dictionary in crates/proof/src/hu/mod.rs.
- src/aff.rs: upper_char_at handles a missing character or invalid UTF-8
  boundary instead of panicking (suggesting for "A" exposed the end-index case).
  src/aff.rs tests end indices, empty input, invalid boundaries and case expansion.
- Cargo.toml: retain only the library's runtime dependencies; constrain hashbrown
  to 0.16 and foldhash to 0.2, already present in WordCraft's lockfile. The
  upstream dev tooling, examples and test dictionaries are not redistributed.
- src/checker.rs: evaluate chained-affix conditions after removing each affix;
  compare distinct preceding code points for SIMPLIFIEDTRIPLE compounds; use
  prefix continuation flags for suffix-plus-two-prefix checks.
- src/suggester/ngram.rs: preserve the suffix when expanding cross-product
  suggestions. Targeted synthetic regression tests cover these fixes.
- src/test_fixture.rs: original, small MPL-2.0 WordCraft test data replaces the
  absent, separately GPL-licensed upstream English test dictionary. It tests
  mechanisms, not general English dictionary coverage. Test-only LazyLock uses
  the Rust standard library rather than once_cell; doctests use inline data.
  The complete vendored unit-test and doctest targets can run independently
  and are included in cargo xtask ci. PATCHES.txt maps the original five fixes and subsequent safety/loading changes to
  their independent regressions and lists the separate packaging/test changes.

- Safe Box storage replaces raw memory handling; fallible affix conversion and
  checked UTF-8 edits replace panic paths. The crate forbids unsafe code and
  enforces the production never-crash lints in CI.
- DictionaryBuilder parses in batches for responsive native and browser UIs.
  The synchronous constructor uses the same parser and error handling. A parse
  failure stays terminal even when a caller retries advance before finish.

- Numeric flags honor AF aliases, matching upstream fix
  119625e5b6fb374e818e2372c8860aa7202e16bb, with a synthetic regression.

The modified source files remain MPL-2.0. This directory contains the source
corresponding to WordCraft's bundled copy. Distributors of compiled WordCraft
must make this source (including modifications) available under its MPL notice,
and tell recipients how to obtain it. Dictionary assets have separate notices.
